details:
- rebuild with golang 1.22.9-1.el9_2.tuxcare.els26 to fix Go standard library CVEs
- CVE-2026-33818: enforce a maximum recursion depth in parseField and
  parseSequenceOf in encoding/asn1, so a deeply nested crafted DER payload can no
  longer exhaust the stack while unmarshalling
- CVE-2026-56860: resolve reference paths on a byte buffer with index-based
  backtracking in net/url instead of rebuilding a string on every ".." segment,
  removing the quadratic time and allocation cost
- CVE-2026-56862: only treat application data, and handshake records seen before
  the handshake completes, as state-advancing in crypto/tls, so a peer can no
  longer spam post-handshake KeyUpdate messages to force unbounded key derivation
